'''Nosaurian''' was the language spoken by the [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurians]] of [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]]. The Nosaurian language consisted of barks, warbles and hissing sibilants.<ref name="u" />

[[Written Nosaurian]] combined two different alphabets from ancient times. The written form also included metaphors about nature, weather and seasonal cycles.<ref name="u" />
